description: This line plot, titled "Massive Activation of atten_output_gate," illustrates the maximum activation values across layers for three distinct components: "atten_output" (blue dashed line with circle markers), "atten_residual" (green dashed line with triangle markers), and "ffn_residual" (red solid line with dot markers). The x-axis represents the "Layer" number, ranging from 0 to approximately 25, with tick labels at intervals of 5, indicating a linear scale without units specified. The y-axis represents the "Max Activation Value," scaled linearly from 0 to 400, with tick marks at intervals of 50. The "atten_output" line starts near 0 at layer 0, remains low until layer 20, then sharply increases to approximately 40 by layer 25. The "atten_residual" line begins near 0 at layer 0, remains low until layer 20, then rises steeply to approximately 250 by layer 25. The "ffn_residual" line starts near 0 at layer 0, rises gradually to approximately 120 by layer 20, and then increases sharply to approximately 380 by layer 25. All three lines exhibit a clear upward trend in activation values as the layer index increases, with the "ffn_residual" line consistently showing the highest activation values throughout the plotted range.
